academic.title: Sessions and terms
academic.intro: Set up each school year and its three terms. The current session and term decide what students, teachers and parents see.
academic.noSessions: No sessions yet. Add the first one below.
academic.noTerms: No terms in this session yet.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Create accounts for staff, students and parents. Each person gets an email to set their own password.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.narrowSearch: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Narrow the search to see others.
accounts.pendingHint: Not activated yet: a new activation email goes to the new address.
accounts.emailHint: Changing it signs the person out everywhere. They sign in with the new address.
accounts.emailAccepted: An activation email for {{email}} was accepted by the email service.
accounts.emailRejected: The activation email for {{email}} was not sent because no email service is configured or it refused the message.

students.title: Students and classes
students.introWithSession: Placing students in classes for {{session}}. Choosing a different class moves the student.
students.intro: Students and their classes for the current session.
students.noSession: No session is current. Set one under Sessions and terms before placing students in classes.
students.noStudents: No students found. Create student accounts under Accounts.
students.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Search to find others.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.intro: Link parent accounts to their children. Only administrators can change these links, so a parent only ever sees the children linked here.
guardians.confirmRemove: Remove {{parent}} as a guardian of {{student}}? They will no longer see this child's records.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.intro: The weekly lessons for each class, Monday to Friday. A class cannot have two lessons at once, and a teacher cannot be in two classes at once. Teachers shown come from Teaching assignments.
timetable.noLessons: No lessons for this class yet. Add the first one.
timetable.noSubjects: This class has no subjects yet. Add them under Classes and subjects.
timetable.subject: Subject
